cover.subtitle: Prepared from an evidence-based local visibility review

executive_snapshot.foundation_summary: Mesa Valley Plumbing has a solid local presence with a verified Google Business Profile and a consistent 4.6-star rating across recent reviews. The business appears in searches for core plumbing services in the Mesa area.
executive_snapshot.key_observation: Several local listing inconsistencies and a below-average review volume compared to a relevant local competitor represent the most actionable near-term opportunities.
priority_areas: Fix inconsistent business information across local listings
Strengthen Google Business Profile service coverage
Build a consistent genuine review acquisition process

business_foundation.intro: The following areas represent genuine strengths identified during the audit.

strengths.observation: Your GBP is verified and contains core business information, photos, and service categories.
Your 4.6-star rating is strong and reflects genuine customer satisfaction.
Your business is listed on the major platforms including Google, Yelp, and the Better Business Bureau.

top_priorities.title: Fix Inconsistent Business Information
top_priorities.what_we_found: Your business phone number and address appear in different formats across several important local directories.
top_priorities.why_it_matters: When search systems and potential customers encounter conflicting information, it can reduce trust and affect how your business appears in local searches.
top_priorities.recommended_action: Correct the affected listings to use the same accurate business name, address, and phone number consistently across all platforms.

top_priorities.title: Strengthen GBP Service Coverage
top_priorities.what_we_found: Your Google Business Profile does not clearly list several of your core plumbing services, including water heater installation and emergency services.
top_priorities.why_it_matters: Customers searching for specific services may not find your business if those services are not clearly represented on your profile.
top_priorities.recommended_action: Update your GBP service list to clearly include all major services your business provides, with concise descriptions.

top_priorities.title: Build a Consistent Review Acquisition Process
top_priorities.what_we_found: Mesa Valley Plumbing has 47 Google reviews. A relevant local competitor has 182 reviews, with more consistent recent activity.
top_priorities.why_it_matters: A higher volume of recent, genuine reviews improves trust with potential customers and reflects active customer engagement.
top_priorities.recommended_action: Create a simple, consistent process for asking satisfied customers to leave a genuine review after each service call.

top_priorities.title: Improve Website Structured Information
top_priorities.what_we_found: Your website is missing structured data (schema markup) that helps search engines clearly understand your business type, location, and services.
top_priorities.why_it_matters: Structured data helps search engines correctly categorize your business, which can improve how your business appears in local search results.
top_priorities.recommended_action: Add basic local business schema markup to your website including business name, address, phone, and service categories.

competitive_snapshot.intro: The following comparison is based on validated public data for one relevant local competitor.

comparisons.observation: SunState has 182 Google reviews (vs. 47) and a 4.8 rating (vs. 4.6). Their GBP includes 14 service categories vs. 6.
comparisons.opportunity: Closing the review volume gap and expanding GBP service coverage represents a meaningful reputation opportunity.

growth_opportunities.intro: Additional opportunities identified during the audit that did not reach the Top 5 threshold.

opportunities.title: Add Business Photos to GBP
opportunities.observation: Your GBP currently has 3 photos. Businesses with more photos tend to see higher engagement.
opportunities.suggested_action: Add 8-12 quality photos showcasing your team, vehicles, and completed work.

opportunities.title: Claim Missing Minor Directory Listings
opportunities.observation: Your business was not found on 3 smaller local directories that are relevant for plumbing services.
opportunities.suggested_action: Claim and complete listings on Angi, HomeAdvisor, and Thumbtack to broaden local coverage.

recommended_next_steps.intro: Based on the audit findings, here is a recommended sequence of improvements:

steps.action: Correct inconsistent business information across all affected local listings.
Update your Google Business Profile to include all core services with clear descriptions.
Build a simple process for requesting genuine reviews from satisfied customers after each service.
Add local business schema markup to your website.
